headline: Reliance Industries Q3 EBITDA grows 11.2% led by Retail and Jio
summary: Reliance Industries reported a strong quarterly performance with consolidated EBITDA touching INR 44,678 crore. Jio subscriber additions remained strong.
raw_text: Reliance Industries Limited reported consolidated EBITDA of INR 44,678 crore for the third quarter ended December 31, 2024.

headline: Jio crosses 480 million subscribers as 5G adoption accelerates
summary: Reliance Jio added 11.8 million net subscribers in Q3 FY25 with ARPU rising to INR 182.4.
raw_text: Jio Platforms Limited reported robust subscriber additions and high data consumption growth across enterprise and consumer 5G.

headline: TCS reports 25.0% EBIT margin and $8.1B TCV in Q3
summary: Tata Consultancy Services posted resilient operating margins and strong order wins driven by AI WisdomNext and cloud deals.
raw_text: TCS delivered 25.0% operating margin and declared interim and special dividends totaling INR 28 per share.

headline: Infosys wins $3.2B large deals in Q3, raises revenue guidance
summary: Infosys demonstrated solid deal momentum with 71% net new deals and strong adoption of Infosys Topaz AI platform.
raw_text: Infosys reported Q3 FY25 constant currency revenue growth of 5.1% YoY with Free Cash Flow conversion at 106% of net profit.

headline: HDFC Bank Q3 Net Profit jumps 33.5% post-merger, GNPA improves to 1.26%
summary: HDFC Bank reported net profit of INR 16,372 crore with improved asset quality and deposit growth of 27.7% YoY.
raw_text: HDFC Bank maintained strong balance sheet resilience with Capital Adequacy Ratio at 18.4%.

headline: ITC Q3 Net Profit rises 10.7% to INR 5,400 Cr; declares INR 6.25 dividend
summary: ITC delivered steady FMCG margin expansion and record RevPAR in Hotels while approving interim dividend of INR 6.25 per share.
raw_text: ITC Limited registered gross revenue of INR 18,608 crore supported by FMCG, Agri and Hotels segment growth.
